= The APF Directory of Foresight Blogs, Newsletters & Signal Feeds: 350 Curated Publications =

Environmental scanning requires continuous monitoring of weak signals, technological inflections, and institutional experiments. This directory catalogs 350 leading practitioner newsletters, Substack publications, and think tank signal channels.

== Explore the 350 Blogs & Newsletters ==
